messages.subject: Energy & Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Bennett,

Your executive-search work across energy, mining and infrastructure makes this a relevant introduction for senior international mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where resources growth, regulatory credibility, government relationships, stakeholder confidence and responsible development intersect. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets alongside broader global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
